WITH customer_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    ft.transaction_amount,
    c.state_county_province
  FROM Financial_Transactions ft
  JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE ft.transaction_amount IS NOT NULL
),
state_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    state_county_province,
    SUM(transaction_amount) as state_total
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY state_county_province
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(state_total) as overall_total
  FROM state_totals
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    st.state_county_province,
    st.state_total,
    st.state_total / gt.overall_total as share
  FROM state_totals st
  CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
),
average_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM state_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.state_county_province,
    ss.state_total,
    ss.share,
    asc.avg_share
  FROM state_shares ss
  CROSS JOIN average_share_calc asc
  WHERE ss.share > asc.avg_share
)
SELECT
  SUM(state_total) as combined_total,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess
FROM above_average
